papers.title_en: TokenMatte: Unlocking T2V Diffusion Priors for Pixel-Native Video Matting
papers.authors: Zanyi Wang, Dengyang Jiang, Fengfei Yu, Shilong Liu
papers.evidence: 无需辅助输入的视频抠图，处理发丝与软边界
papers.tldr: 高分辨率视频抠像需恢复连续alpha、细发和运动模糊，但密集alpha监督稀缺。TokenMatte把预训练视频DiT改为单次、无需辅助输入的RGB到alpha预测器，用共享线性读出将时空token直接映射为alpha像素块，平铺成全分辨率序列。与匹配潜空间基线相比，它精度更高、推理加速1.51倍，并在三个基准上取得无辅助输入新SOTA。该方法绕开alpha的VAE编解码损失与开销，释放T2V扩散先验用于像素原生抠像。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution video matting requires accurate recovery of continuous alpha values, including fine hair, soft boundaries, and motion blur, yet dense alpha supervision remains scarce. Pretrained text-to-video diffusion transformers (DiTs) offer rich spatio-temporal priors, whereas existing generative video matting approaches typically route alpha predictions through RGB-trained VAE latents, which can attenuate fine details and introduce additional decoding overhead. We present TokenMatte, which adapts a pretrained video DiT into a single-pass, auxiliary-free RGB-to-alpha predictor with a pixel-native output interface. At its core is a single shared linear readout that maps each spatio-temporal token directly to its corresponding ($t \times p \times p$) block of alpha pixels, predicting spatial details and temporal variations within the same local video block. Tiling these blocks produces the full-resolution alpha sequence without a convolutional decoder or learned upsampling. The predicted alpha is supervised directly in pixel space, while the ground-truth alpha never enters the VAE, eliminating target-side alpha encoding and output-side VAE decoding. Leveraging the pretrained video prior, TokenMatte is trained using only existing public matting datasets, without additional data curation or auxiliary inputs at inference. Compared with a matched latent-output baseline, our pixel-native interface improves matting accuracy while achieving a 1.51$\times$ inference speedup. TokenMatte establishes a new auxiliary-free state of the art on VideoMatte, YouTubeMatte, and V-HIM60.

papers.title_en: FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues
papers.authors: Ashkan Ganj, Hang Su, Tian Guo
papers.evidence: 将冻结深度基础先验锚定到对焦线索实现零样本度量深度
papers.tldr: 现有基于对焦的深度估计在弱对焦线索、新相机或焦切片少时性能受限。FocusAnchor用循环模型通过focus-volume查找细化度量深度，并反复将冻结基础模型的相对深度先验与当前估计对齐，形成反馈闭环。相比FOSSA ViT-B，NYU Depth V2上AbsRel降36%，五个零样本基准均取得最低AbsRel。该工作提升跨相机与少切片场景鲁棒性，支持更实用的移动采集。
papers.abstract_en: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

papers.title_en: Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation
papers.evidence: 将 Depth Anything V2 蒸馏为可跑在边缘加速器上的 24.5M 轻量学生模型
papers.tldr: 小型机器人只有单目相机与数瓦算力，可深度基础模型却是GPU级视觉Transformer，量化到Hailo-8L后因softmax权重低于int8步长而大片丢场景。作者改用蒸馏：无注意力的ResNet-34 U-Net学生模仿Depth Anything V2-Large，芯片上达27.1 FPS。配合仅需相机高度的地面交线测距，建图、hybrid-A*与SLAM全在Pi CPU运行，硬件在环10场景中7.9±1.1次无碰撞达点。
papers.abstract_en: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.

papers.title_en: PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model
papers.authors: Zeyu Ren, Jie Ni, Rui Qian, Jiahao Wei, Hao Tang, Yongtai Liu, Zeyu Zhang
papers.evidence: 单次前向同时预测实例图与几何
papers.tldr: 场景理解需同时恢复几何与语义，现有方法多依赖独立网络或多步推理，效率与一致性受限。PINE用一步 Omni Diffusion Transformer 一次前向预测点图、表面法线和实例图，并以 token 流掩码控制交互、相机射线编码定位 token、DINOv3 特征增强注意力。仅用13.9万张合成图训练，即在点图与法线任务取得领先，实例分割超过 SAM 大物体表现，三图预测比 MoGe-3+SAM 快5.7倍。该工作展示了统一一步扩散模型在多任务场景理解中的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

papers.title_en: HS-OVSeg: Multi-Granularity Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing via Heterogeneous Supervision
papers.authors: Wei Huang, Chenying Liu, Xudong Kang, Xiao Xiang Zhu
papers.evidence: 文本驱动的开放词汇语义分割
papers.tldr: 遥感开放词汇语义分割依赖精确像素标注，但大规模多语义像素级数据稀缺，而现有遥感数据富含场景与对象级标注。HS-OVSeg将场景、对象和像素级监督统一起来，利用SAM3按类别名与检测框生成伪标签，并结合真值掩码和LoRA微调。方法在20个遥感数据集上训练，并在20个训练源及5个留出集上显著超越现有RS-OVSS模型。该工作展示了异构监督下多粒度分割的潜力，为缓解像素标注瓶颈提供了新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables flexible, text-driven mapping of remote sensing (RS) imagery beyond predefined categories. Despite advances in segmentation foundation models, RS-OVSS remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale, semantically diverse datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations. Meanwhile, existing RS datasets contain abundant scene- and object-level annotations that offer valuable semantic information but lack precise pixel-wise supervision. To exploit these complementary sources, we propose HS-OVSeg, a unified training framework that integrates heterogeneous scene-, object-, and pixel-level supervision for RS-OVSS. Specifically, we generate pixel-wise pseudo-labels using SAM3, conditioned on scene-level class names and object-level class names with bounding boxes. Combined with ground-truth semantic masks, these pseudo-labels enable joint training across all three annotation granularities through LoRA-based fine-tuning of SAM3. Our unified training spans 20 RS datasets, including 3 scene classification, 4 object detection, and 13 semantic segmentation datasets, with 1,000 images from the 7 classification and detection datasets manually annotated for pixel-level evaluation. HS-OVSeg substantially outperforms existing RS-OVSS models across both the 20 training-source and 5 held-out datasets, demonstrating strong multi-granularity segmentation capabilities under heterogeneous supervision. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

papers.title_en: MIR-Depth: Multi-Range Refinement for Single-View RGB-D Depth Completion of Transparent Objects
papers.authors: Xinzhe Fu, Qi Shao, Yuanfei Xie, Taoyu Wu, Zhihao Cao, Long Hu, Hong Liang, Xianzhi Li, Anh Nguyen, Baoru Huang, Rongsheng Li
papers.evidence: 针对透明物体的单视图深度补全与折射偏移
papers.tldr: 透明物体单视角RGB-D深度补全面向机器人抓取，需从单张RGB-D和掩码恢复可见表面深度，但镜面反射导致深度缺失、折射使非零返回混入背景，原始测量难以作为可靠锚点。MIR-Depth构建坐标感知多范围假设，结合3D聚合全局逆深度体与深度轴滤波的逐像素局部体，并用选择性循环细化和空间门控校正迭代优化，以缓解单搜索区间难以兼顾大折射偏移与局部分辨率的矛盾。在TransCG、TODD等五个数据集上误差低于ReMake、DFNet、BP-Net和PSD，真机6-DoF抓取验证了表面几何精度。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering accurate visible-surface depth from a single RGB-D image and an object mask is essential for robotic grasping and manipulation of transparent objects. Specular reflections cause missing depth, while refraction corrupts nonzero returns with background depth, making raw measurements unreliable as surface anchors. Under a fixed sampling budget, refining an initial single-view prediction within a single search interval either misses large refraction offsets or sacrifices fine local resolution. To resolve this single-view trade-off, MIR-Depth constructs Coordinate-Aware Multi-Range Hypotheses: a 3D-aggregated global inverse-depth volume and depth-axis-filtered pixel-wise local volumes around a prior-guided initial depth. Selective Recurrent Refinement then introduces out-of-bounds lookup masking and validity-masked softmax fusion to iteratively update inverse depth from these volumes using a multi-scale ConvGRU. Finally, Spatially Gated Correction applies a learned per-pixel spatial gate to the full-resolution residual, preserving accurate initial geometry without imposing raw sensor readings as hard constraints. Experiments on TransCG, TODD, TRansPose, ClearPose, and HouseCat6D show that MIR-Depth achieves lower error than ReMake, DFNet, BP-Net, and PSD. Real-robot evaluations confirm accurate surface geometry for 6-DoF grasp pose prediction. Code and pretrained models will be publicly available.
